Which statement about stainless steel is correct?
A
All atoms in stainless steel are the same size.
B
Stainless steel is a mixture of copper and zinc.
C
Stainless steel is an iron compound.
D
Stainless steel is stronger than pure iron.

options.label: A
options.text: All atoms in stainless steel are the same size.

options.label: B
options.text: Stainless steel is a mixture of copper and zinc.

options.label: C
options.text: Stainless steel is an iron compound.

options.label: D
options.text: Stainless steel is stronger than pure iron.
